verdict.rationale: LegalZoom shows only adjacent corporate record-keeping tools: AI-generated meeting minutes, a library of 150+ customizable legal documents and cloud document storage. None of the evidence names board consents or resolutions specifically, and nothing shows a way to collect approvals online. Missing for 10: explicit board consent/resolution templates, online approval or e-signature collection from directors, a documented approval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
